notablePrerequisites: Vessel of the All-Consuming has a power of at least ten.
description:
Cast Chandra's Ignition by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing Vessel of the All-Consuming to deal damage equal to its power to each other creature and each opponent.
Vessel of the All-Consuming triggers, causing each opponent to lose the game.
